## History

Elder Clow is a local figure involved with the community and church attended by the Meredith family. She is present alongside [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) following the Sunday church service where [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) faints from fasting for the Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club). During this incident, Elder Clow hears [Faith](../character/faith.md) explain to her father that the children are essentially raising themselves.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P1](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XI.
